summary: Review cache-backed flows for key correctness, invalidation, stale reads, multi-tenant isolation and write ordering.

must_inspect.why: Cache keys must include every dimension required to prevent cross-user/tenant or variant collisions.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer collision when a wrapper already namespaces keys.

must_inspect.why: Mutations should not leave materially stale cached state beyond the intended consistency model.
false_positive_guards: TTL alone can be intentional eventual consistency; evaluate against stated invariant.

must_inspect.why: Concurrent misses or write ordering can amplify load or reintroduce stale values.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand stampede protection for low-cost/low-volume caches.
